name: robots/centre-for-biorobotics__eeuvsim_gazebo
title: eeUVsim U-CAT AUV simulator
intro: eeUVsim U-CAT AUV simulator, adapted from centre-for-biorobotics/eeuvsim_gazebo. It reads `name`, `pose`, `twist`, `reference_frame` and 6 more; runs `set_fin_oscillation` and `publish_reset`. `set_fin_oscillation`: publish one Flippers message with the four fin oscillation commands on /hw/flippers_cmd. The receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not that moveFins applied it or that the AUV moved or stopped. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
